settings.question: Can I spray ZARAN directly on my skin?
settings.answer: We recommend spraying ZARAN on your clothes instead of directly on skin — collar, chest or sleeves. It sits better on fabric and stays longer.

settings.question: What is your refund policy?
settings.answer: Easy 15-day refund. The bottle must have at least 90% of the perfume remaining — message us on WhatsApp to start your return.

settings.question: How long does the fragrance last?
settings.answer: ZARAN is made to linger — sprayed on clothes, it stays noticeable for 8+ hours, living up to our promise: Scents That Stay.
